nodes.name: persistence.rs
nodes.summary: Comprehensive SQLite repository and migration integration suite covering CRUD, progress bounds, transactions, foreign keys, metadata caches, and upgrades from every released profile fixture.

nodes.name: library_request
nodes.summary: Builds a deterministic library-entry request for persistence scenarios.

nodes.name: snapshot
nodes.summary: Creates a representative cached media snapshot with configurable episode totals.

nodes.name: repository_crud_status_transition_and_restart_persistence
nodes.summary: Verifies library CRUD, status transitions, and durable state after closing and reopening the database.

nodes.name: progress_bounds_use_known_totals_and_allow_unknown_totals
nodes.summary: Checks that progress respects cached known episode totals while remaining permissive when totals are unavailable.

nodes.name: settings_batch_rolls_back_and_foreign_keys_are_enforced
nodes.summary: Proves failed settings batches roll back atomically and SQLite foreign-key constraints remain enabled.

nodes.name: metadata_settings_and_cache_records_round_trip
nodes.summary: Round-trips settings, media metadata, airing data, and response-cache records through repository APIs.

nodes.name: metadata_snapshot_batches_roll_back_on_any_invalid_record
nodes.summary: Ensures a single invalid metadata snapshot aborts the entire batch without partial writes.

nodes.name: v0001_fixture_upgrades_without_losing_authoritative_records
nodes.summary: Migrates the version-1 fixture to the latest schema while preserving authoritative settings, library, cache, and airing records.

nodes.name: v0002_fixture_preserves_activity_and_applies_activity_progress_migration
nodes.summary: Upgrades the version-2 fixture while preserving watch activity and applying progress high-water migration semantics.

nodes.name: v0003_fixture_adds_stable_identity_and_repairs_skipped_initial_progress
nodes.summary: Upgrades the version-3 fixture, adds portable activity identity, and repairs skipped initial-progress history without losing user data.

nodes.name: app.css
nodes.summary: Global Tailwind and semantic design-token layer implementing Catppuccin Latte and Macchiato palettes, frosted panels, controls, focus states, responsive layouts, and reduced-motion behavior.
nodes.languageNotes: Palette values are centralized as semantic CSS custom properties so components avoid raw color literals.

nodes.name: app.html
nodes.summary: SvelteKit HTML shell defining Animi's document metadata, favicon, viewport, preload behavior, and framework head/body insertion points.

nodes.name: AppNavigation.svelte
nodes.summary: Accessible primary tab navigation for Home, Discover, Dashboard, and Settings with roving Arrow, Home, and End keyboard focus.

nodes.name: AsyncStateNotice.svelte
nodes.summary: Shared accessible presentation for loading, empty, offline, stale, and error states with contextual cat art and optional retry actions.

nodes.name: AsyncStateNotice.test.ts
nodes.summary: Component tests for default and custom asynchronous-state copy, ARIA roles and busy state, decorative artwork, compact styling, and retry eligibility.

nodes.name: ForcedPresentationPanel.svelte
nodes.summary: Settings-debug panel that forces Home, Discover, or Dashboard into a selected terminal presentation state and supports replaying the simulation.

nodes.name: GlassMultiSelect.svelte
nodes.summary: Frosted multi-select combobox with ordered selections, outside-click handling, active-option tracking, and full listbox keyboard behavior.

nodes.name: GlassMultiSelect.test.ts
nodes.summary: Component tests for multi-select opening, toggling, keyboard navigation, selection ordering, and accessible listbox state.

nodes.name: GlassSelect.svelte
nodes.summary: Single-choice frosted combobox implementing outside-click dismissal, focus restoration, cyclic keyboard navigation, and accessible listbox semantics.

nodes.name: GlassSelect.test.ts
nodes.summary: Component tests for the custom select's trigger state, keyboard navigation, option choice, dismissal, and focus restoration.

nodes.name: HomePreviewCover.svelte
nodes.summary: Decorative accessible sample cover renderer that draws moon, rail, or signal motifs with semantic theme colors for Home previews.

nodes.name: LibraryEntryEditor.svelte
nodes.summary: Full library add/edit form handling status, bounded progress, optional score, notes validation, save state, retryable errors, and explicit removal confirmation.

nodes.name: LibraryEntryEditor.test.ts
nodes.summary: Extensive component suite for entry creation and editing, progress and notes validation, status rules, async failures, retries, busy states, and confirmed removal.

nodes.name: savedEntry
nodes.summary: Builds the persisted library-entry response returned by editor test doubles.

nodes.name: MediaCover.svelte
nodes.summary: Lazy-loading media cover component that falls back to a labeled placeholder when the URL is missing or image loading fails.

nodes.name: MediaCover.test.ts
nodes.summary: Component tests for successful cover rendering, lazy-loading attributes, missing-image fallback, failed-load recovery, and accessible labels.

nodes.name: MediaDetailsDialog.svelte
nodes.summary: Modal anime-details experience that loads fresh metadata, preserves summary fallback content, displays freshness and offline errors, formats media facts and sequels, and embeds library editing.

nodes.name: MediaDetailsDialog.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive dialog tests covering focus and close behavior, loading and stale states, offline fallback, metadata formatting, sequel display, and library add/update/remove callbacks.

nodes.name: savedEntry
nodes.summary: Creates a saved library entry corresponding to a dialog editor request for test assertions.

nodes.name: NavigationIcon.svelte
nodes.summary: Decorative SVG icon switcher for the four primary navigation destinations.

nodes.name: PagePlaceholder.svelte
nodes.summary: Reusable glass-panel placeholder presenting a checkpoint label, page title, explanatory copy, and decorative cat motif.

nodes.name: RefreshIcon.svelte
nodes.summary: Small decorative SVG refresh glyph used by retry and metadata-refresh actions.

nodes.name: SleepingCatLoader.svelte
nodes.summary: Timed ASCII sleeping-cat loading animation that cycles frames, cleans up its timer, and remains static when reduced motion is requested.

nodes.name: StaticCatArt.svelte
nodes.summary: Maps empty, stale, offline, and error presentation states to decorative static ASCII cat artwork.

nodes.name: ThemePreferenceControl.svelte
nodes.summary: Accessible appearance settings panel for system, Latte, and Macchiato preferences with loading, saving, success, and retryable error feedback.

nodes.name: navigation.ts
nodes.summary: Canonical primary navigation descriptors and inferred TypeScript unions for view and icon identifiers.
